obsidian-canvas.$description: Obsidian Canvas — Page background, card surfaces, text on light surfaces, hairline borders — the near-black that owns 95% of the interface

bone-white.$description: Bone White — Primary text, inverted card surfaces, link text on violet, subtle inset borders — the only light tone in the system

fog.$description: Fog — Muted secondary text, captions, metadata — sits between the canvas and white in the neutral scale

graphite.$description: Graphite — Elevated surface layer above the canvas, soft card backgrounds, link hover glow — adds a half-step of depth without breaking the monochrome read

electric-iris.$description: Electric Iris — Accent card fills, link/button backgrounds, active state highlights — the one chromatic voice; its vividness is amplified by 99% achromatic surroundings

deep-iris.$description: Deep Iris — Secondary accent surface, deeper violet card variant — used when the primary iris needs a stepped companion for layered cards or gradient-feeling stacks

dennis-sans.$description: Single-family system. Weight 450 is non-standard — not light, not bold, sits in the medium range to feel editorial rather than corporate. Uniform 0.0500em letter-spacing across all sizes creates a distinctive mechanical rhythm. Display sizes (60–216px) use tight line-height (1.00–1.07) so headlines touch or nearly touch; body sizes (14–17px) open up to 1.40–1.66 for readability. The 216px hero name is the signature element — it dwarfs everything else and bleeds off-canvas as intent.
